% Figure A.1 (fig:batched): batched per-vector throughput vs batch size B on geno22full.
% Data in data/fig_batched.dat is GENERATED by ../../extract_results.py from the logs;
% do not transcribe numbers here -- rerun the extractor instead.
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.16}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{cEngine}{HTML}{E66101}   % warm orange
\definecolor{cCusparse}{HTML}{5E3C99} % deep purple
\definecolor{cDefault}{HTML}{B2ABD2}  % light purple
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    font=\footnotesize,
    width=10cm, height=6.6cm,
    xmode=log, log basis x=2,
    xtick={16,32,64,128,256}, xticklabels={16,32,64,128,256},
    xlabel={Batch size $B$},
    ylabel={Per-vector throughput (ms/vector)},
    grid=both, major grid style={gray!30}, minor grid style={gray!12},
    legend pos=north west, legend cell align=left,
    every axis plot/.append style={thick, mark size=2.2pt},
]
\addplot[cEngine, mark=*] table[x=B, y=engine] {data/fig_batched.dat};
\addlegendentry{Grammar Engine (Ours)}
\addplot[cDefault, mark=square*, dashed] table[x=B, y=cusparse_defalg2] {data/fig_batched.dat};
\addlegendentry{cuSPARSE (ALG\_DEFAULT / ALG2)}
\addplot[cCusparse, mark=triangle*] table[x=B, y=cusparse_alg3] {data/fig_batched.dat};
\addlegendentry{cuSPARSE (CSR\_ALG3)}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
